results.title: 5.9 crore returns filed till July 31 deadline: I-T dept
results.description: Nearly 5.9 crore income tax returns were filed by the July 31 deadline. This number is lower than last year's extended filing period. Major tax concessions were announced during the last financial year. Taxpayers can still file returns until December with a penalty. Business income filers have different extended deadlines for their submissions.

results.title: State government chips in $10 million to rebuild North Cronulla surf club
results.description: The state government will contribute a third of the expected cost of rebuilding the North Cronulla surf club.
